selection.what: Joint weighted draw over (technique, region) pairs: P(technique) x P(region|technique), one randf() walk
selection.varies_by: role, range band, plan region bias, fight_iq (fit)

selection.what: Maps each striking role to a weight via FightPlans.FIT_WEIGHTS; AVOID becomes 0.1 not zero
Which of two candidate techniques fires first, from per-technique volume and combo_boost
selection.varies_by: volume (per technique), since_s (combo window 0.35 s, boost 3x)

selection.what: Overall output scale from conditioning, speed and plan pace; does NOT distinguish techniques
selection.varies_by: stats (conditioning, speed), plan pace (cautious 0.80 / balanced 1.0 / aggressive 1.25)

selection.what: Maps each role in the plan's role_priority to a category (PRIMARY/SECONDARY/OPPORTUNISTIC/AVOID)
Prices the four role categories: PRIMARY=3.0, SECONDARY=1.0, OPPORTUNISTIC=0.5, AVOID=-2.0 (clamped to 0.1 in _role_weights)
selection.varies_by: role category (same weight for every technique of that category)

selection.what: Filters the arsenal by stance and range band; each returned move carries fit=1.0 if the gap suits, mismatch_weight if not
selection.varies_by: range band, stance, fight_iq (MISMATCH_MAX 0.30 at iq=0, 0.0 at iq=100)

selection.what: Tier ceiling for the default arsenal; a fighter with no technique_progress knows tier 1 and 2
